newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak central bank passes forex position measures.
newsitem.headline: Slovak central bank passes forex position measures.

text.p: The Slovak central bank on Thursday said it had approved a previously-announced measure changing the reporting requirements for foreign exchange.
Under the new rules to take effect from January 1, banks are required to exclude foreign exchange assets held locally from their foreign exchange position for monetary purposes.
They will also have to include crown liabilities to banks outside Slovakia.
"This measure takes effect on January 1, 1997, ... and is temporary, conditioned by a significant improvement of the current situation in Slovakia's trade and payments balance," the statement added.
Further details on the measures were not immediately available.
The central bank added that it would contribute 500 million crowns to the state budget.
